name: Peat & Deadwood
description: Dug peat seasons in place over two months into a cool, very long-burning fuel - the banked-fire counterpart to Immersive Firewood's hot, year-seasoned wood. Adds fallen deadwood logs for day-one scavenging, restores driftwood splitting, and gives Immersive Firewood per-species seasoning times. Recommends Drying Speed Overhaul.
